This is Anthony Fenech and I cover the Tigers for the Detroit Free Press. With Michigan advancing to the College World Series, I'm going to be staying in Omaha after the Tigers-Royals kickoff game on Thursday to cover U-M. Working on a story looking back at the 1984 team. If you have any time to chat, let me know. I'm at 734-752-9667.
